name: Scan to BIM
intro: Iphakamisa amaphansi, amadonga, iminyango namawindi wesakhiwo kusuka ekhwayeni lamaphoyinti elivulekile. Isiphakamiso ngasinye sibonisa ukuthi sikhashelwe kangakanani kumaphoyinti oskenisiwe. Wamukela, uhlele noma wenqabe; akukho okudwetshwayo kuze kube yilapho wamukela.
cloud.none: Akukho khwaya lamaphoyinti olivulekile. Vula Amakhwaya amaphoyinti ku-Izilungiselelo, Okuvamile, Okwengeziwe, bese wakha ikhwaya lapho (vula imodeli kuqala), bese ubuyela lapha.
err.noplanes: Iphansi alitholakanga: ikhwaya alinayo indawo eyisicaba enhle. Hlola ukuthi uskeni ufaka iphansi.
err.fewpoints: Amaphoyinti {n} kuphela aphakathi kalo phansi nesiling salo: ancane kakhulu ukuthola amadonga.
floors.note: Atholakele ngokuphakama lapho amaphoyinti amaningi ekhona ezingeni elilodwa. Indawo eyisicaba engaphezu kuka-1.8 m ngaphezu kwephansi ithathwa njengesiling salo; ezisezingeni eliphansi (isihlahla setafula) ziyashiywa ngaphandle. Lokhu kuyisibikezelo: uma kungalungile, thayipha ukuphakama.
f.thickness: Ukuqina kodonga okuzothathwa uma kuskenwe uhlangothi olulodwa kuphela
level.create: Akukho zinga lemodeli elingaphakathi kuka-150 mm kulo phansi. Ukwamukela kudala izinga {name}, ukuphakama: {z} mm.
proposals.note: Kufundwe ngamaphoyinti {n} alesi sitezi; amadonga ngohlaka lwamaphoyinti {slice} amile ngu-1.2 m ngaphezu kwephansi. Izikhala seplenini zingamamilimitha, zilinganiswe ngamaphoyinti oskenisiwe (inani lamaphoyinti lisebhulaketini).
from.points.tip: Zombili izinhlangothi zalo donga zaskenwa, ngakho ukuqina kwalo kuyalinganiswa.
from.assumed.tip: Uhlangothi olulodwa kuphela lwaskenwa, ngakho ukuqina akukwazi ukulinganiswa; lesi yisibalo owacela ukuthi sithathwe.
hfrom.ceiling.tip: Ukuskena kubonisa isiling ngaphezu kwalo phansi.
hfrom.points.tip: Asikho isiling esibonakele; lokhu kuyiphezulu lwamaphoyinti odonga lwalo.
walls.none: Akukho donga olutholakele ngu-1.2 m ngaphezu kwalo phansi. Ukuskena kungase kube ngakubi kakhulu, noma ukuphakama kokusika kungase kungahlangani namadonga (amakamelo angunxande kuphela).
done.propose: Kuphakanyisiwe amadonga {w}, izimbobo {o} namaphansi {f}. Akukadwetshwa lutho.
done.preview: Kuboniswa embonweni wepulani wesitezi, kulayeri yalolu hlelo okwengeziwe. Ukwenqaba noma ukwamukela kuyisusa.
done.accept: Kudwetshwe amadonga {w}, izimbobo {o} namaphansi {f} ngesinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
preview.label: Bonisa iziphakamiso zokuskena
accept.label: Amadonga, izimbobo namaphansi okuskenwe
disclaimer: Lezi yiziphakamiso ezivela ekuskeneni, ukuze zihlolwe ngokumelene nesakhiwo. Kufundwa amakamelo angunxande kuphela. Isithunzi ekuskeneni sibukeka njengesimbobo, nodonga obonwe ohlangothini olulodwa alinabo ububanzi obulinganiswayo. Akusikho ukuhlola umhlaba.
